verdict.rationale: Syncing saved hosts and connection settings across devices is a fair question for a Git client, but the evidence pack never documents syncing hosting-provider configs, identities, or connection settings between devices. Auto-Sync and Background Sync handle committing, pulling and pushing repository content, which is a different capability. The community report of moving data during an app migration is a one-time move, not ongoing cross-device sync.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can sync my saved hosts and connection settings across all my devices
